prova:
intro n hn
  have h1 : 1 < 2 ^ n - 1 := by
    have : 2 ^ n - 1 ≥ 2 := by
      have h2n : 2 ≤ n := by omega
      have h2p : 2 ^ 2 ≤ 2 ^ n := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by norm_num) h2n
      omega
    omega
  have h2 : 2 < 2 * n := by omega
  have h3 : (2 : ℕ) < Nat.maxPrimeFac (2 ^ n - 1) := by
    have : 2 ∣ 2 ^ n - 1 := by
      have h1 : (2 : ℕ) ^ n % 2 = 0 := by
        have : n ≥ 1 := by omega
        have : (2 : ℕ) ^ n % 2 = 0 := by
          induction' ‹_› with n ih
          · norm_num
          · simp [Nat.pow_succ, Nat.mul_mod, ih]
        exact this
      omega
    Nat.maxPrimeFac_gt_one h1
  exact Nat.lt_of_sub_lt (by omega) (Nat.sub_le _ _)
